cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

mechanism: A coaches its former negotiating pupil to treat a broken kettle as a striking colleague, turning B practical offer into a shared bargaining action.
confusable: Not merely declaring an object alive: A recruits B into a negotiation because it claims that account is useful for getting tea.
comparison: Route guidance versus inclusion as grievance resolution.
seedUse: D151 kettle/water/clients/meeting/chair; S05 learned listening before offering.
